name: Ida
source:
A Norwegian lady who is passionate about her work as a personal fitness trainer.

She specializes in helping her client's lose weight.

She is dating her 4 year boyfriend Fredrik and laments their current inability to communicate properly with each other.   

[spoiler]She becomes Jörgen's sex slave in the bad ending after Jörgen spends weeks training her to become his ideal sex slave.[spoiler]
